support_bodies.name: west Z-seam slide-head square catch
support_bodies.rationale: The -X rail's broad, flat slide-head underside is the Z seam's one down-looking face on this floor-down piece. Lifting a seated back-top lands that piece's flat foot on this complete bearing plane. Its two interface islands are the one run either side of the required 12 mm PRV passage; that opening also lets the support body root on the bed outside the flank instead of on the arm's under-flare.

support_bodies.name: west handhold lifting ceiling
support_bodies.rationale: The handhold keeps a flat bearing ceiling for upward finger contact, with 12 mm of roof section above it. This support reaches the back half of that ceiling from the print bed through the open bottom, with 34.20 mm of build-up. The opening gives direct access to remove the complete body.

support_bodies.name: east handhold lifting ceiling
support_bodies.rationale: The handhold keeps a flat bearing ceiling for upward finger contact, with 12 mm of roof section above it. This support reaches the back half of that ceiling from the print bed through the open bottom, with 34.20 mm of build-up. The opening gives direct access to remove the complete body.

support_bodies.name: east Z-seam slide-head square catch
support_bodies.rationale: The +X rail's broad, flat slide-head underside mirrors the west one and remains continuous because nothing crosses this flank. With no opening through the wall beside it, the support has no lane to the bed and roots on the arm's own 45 degree under-flare 8.00 mm below the bearing plane.

support_bodies.name: ASSE round seats and drip-pan sleeve and berth
support_bodies.rationale: The two round seats locate the ASSE fitting; the sleeve lid, rim-rebate shoulders and berth floor retain and support the removable pan. Their working sections remain round or flat as required. This bed-rooted tree reaches them through the open quadrant and pan openings.

support_bodies.name: west anchor faces, PRV mouth, rail catches and identification pockets
support_bodies.rationale: The water-split seat lip, flow-regulator crown, seat lip and tie-band flank, and flavour-line anchor flank retain their tube and tie clearances. The PRV mouth keeps its passage floor, the two west Z-seam foot faces bear against lift, and the identification pockets keep their locating arcs. This bed-rooted tree reaches the ten contact islands through the open quadrant and its wall passages.

support_bodies.name: the water-split rib's tie-band crown; the water-split rib's tie-band flank
support_bodies.rationale: Roots on the ceiling slab's interior face and reaches 2 interface island(s): the water-split rib's tie-band crown; the water-split rib's tie-band flank.

support_bodies.name: the ASSE tie cavity's lower threshold
support_bodies.rationale: Roots on the ceiling slab's interior face and reaches 1 interface island(s): the ASSE tie cavity's lower threshold.

support_bodies.rationale: Roots on the plate around the bedded piece or through its openings and reaches 4 interface island(s): an identification-chip pocket's lower arc; the keystone pocket's floor; the keystone snap catch.

support_bodies.name: west handhold lifting ceiling
support_bodies.rationale: The lifting ceiling keeps its flat hand-bearing face. This bed-rooted support reaches it through the open bottom and is removed through the handhold before assembly.

support_bodies.name: west Z-seam slide-head square catch
support_bodies.rationale: The west rail keeps a broad flat bearing against lift along the top piece’s full foot. The support roots on the arm’s 45 degree under-flare, 8.00 mm below the catch. The lower and middle Y-seam passages have no separate support interface.

support_bodies.name: east handhold lifting ceiling
support_bodies.rationale: The lifting ceiling keeps its flat hand-bearing face. This bed-rooted support reaches it through the open bottom and is removed through the handhold before assembly.

support_bodies.name: east Z-seam slide-head square catch
support_bodies.rationale: The east rail keeps a broad flat bearing against lift along the top piece’s full foot. The support roots on the arm’s 45 degree under-flare, 8.00 mm below the catch. The lower and middle Y-seam passages have no separate support interface.

support_bodies.name: pump-bay lintel
support_bodies.rationale: The fixed roof carries the display and ridge wall above the cartridge withdrawal envelope. Its flat underside runs to the bay bulkhead and is accessible through the empty cartridge bay for support removal.

support_bodies.name: spring bores, carrier bearings and recesses, hardware well crowns and pump-jack roof
support_bodies.rationale: The round bores guide both return springs. The flat upper web bearings and both flank recess ceilings guide and capture the carrier. The four hardware well crowns join the valve tray, and the keyed jack roof seats its plug. This connected support is accessible through the empty cartridge bay, flank openings, aft recess and tee wells before hardware is installed.

support_bodies.name: X- pump boss-bearing shoulder
support_bodies.rationale: The flat annular shoulder bears axially on the fitted pump boss while the complete octagonal wall locates X, Y and yaw. Chamfering the shoulder would trade away bearing area rather than remove an accidental overhang; its centre bore remains open for direct support removal.

support_bodies.name: X- pump-cartridge pull roof
support_bodies.rationale: The pull keeps a flat roof at the neighboring tee-carrier grip's roof plane because both faces carry the same squeeze motion. One tree reaches that roof from the print bed through the open side pocket after 51.00 mm of build-up; the complete body is directly accessible for removal.

support_bodies.name: closed finger-pocket roof
support_bodies.rationale: The pocket roof is the flat hand-contact plane shared with the cartridge pull. The rounded mouth gives direct access to remove its support on the loose half.

support_bodies.name: internal rim and seam-rail relief
support_bodies.rationale: The retaining rim and grip root share a flat lower face above the enclosure seam rail. The outer cup floor remains bedded. Support beneath the inboard relief and projecting rim ends is accessible on the loose half.

support_bodies.name: central M3 lap underside
support_bodies.rationale: The lap keeps its flat fastening section above the tee run ends. This bed-rooted support is removed through the open center end before joining the halves.
